Project: P05 — AI Agent Monitoring and Reliability Platform
Summary: Trace and span ingestion
Description: Implement ingestion pipeline: receive events from /v1/events, enqueue to Redis, normalization worker dequeues, creates/updates traces and spans in DB, acknowledges events. Handle duplicate events (idempotent by event_id). Dead-letter queue for permanently failed events.
Business Value: Reliable event ingestion is the foundation of the observability platform.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Batch of 100 events ingested in < 500ms. 2. Duplicate events handled (idempotent). 3. Dead-letter queue captures failed events. 4. Integration test: ingest → trace appears in DB. 5. Load test: 100 events/sec sustained 60s.
Technical Notes: Redis Streams for queue. Worker uses XACK for acknowledgment. idempotency_key = event_id. On duplicate: skip silently. DLQ: separate Redis list.
Testing Requirements: Integration: ingest → DB verification. Load test: 100 events/sec.
Security Requirements: API key validated before ingestion. project_id from API key — not from event payload.
Definition of Done: Ingestion tested under load. Human reviewer approved.
